description.en:
Who needs dialog when you're this cute? The beautiful (but unlucky) Momoko, the cool, collected Shibumi, and the refreshingly innocent Mayumi star in a "silent manga". No speeches, no dialog! Just pictures, sound effects, and three high school girls living their daily lives.
___
The title "女子かう生" [Joshi Kausei] is "女子高生" [Joshi Kousei] but with the character "高" [Kou] written in historical kana orthography as "かう" [Kau] (though still pronounced "Kou")[¹](https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q13127466338), hence the translation of "High School Girles". ("girle" is a historical form of "girl".)
___
[Defunct Official English (Crunchyroll)](http://www.crunchyroll.com/comics/manga/joshi-kausei/volumes)

___
O título “女子かう生” [Joshi Kausei] é “女子高生” [Joshi Kousei], mas com o caractere “高” [Kou] escrito na ortografia kana histórica como “かう” [Kau] (embora ainda pronunciado “Kou”)[¹](https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q13127466338), daí a tradução de “High School Girles”. Risa Koizumi is the tallest girl in class, and the last thing she wants is the humiliation of standing next to Atsushi Otani, the shortest guy. Fate and the whole school have other ideas, and the two find themselves cast as the unwilling stars of a bizarre romantic comedy duo.

biography.en:
Rumiko Takahashi (高橋 留美子, Takahashi Rumiko, born October 10, 1957) is a Japanese manga artist. With a career of several commercially successful works, beginning with Urusei Yatsura in 1978, Takahashi is one of Japan's best-known and wealthiest manga artists. Her works are popular worldwide, where they have been translated into a variety of languages, with over 200 million copies in circulation. She has won the Shogakukan Manga Award twice, once in 1980 for Urusei Yatsura and again in 2001 for Inuyasha, and the Seiun Award twice, once in 1987 for Urusei Yatsura and again in 1989 for Mermaid Saga. She also received the Grand Prix de la ville d'Angoulême in 2019, becoming the second woman and second Japanese to win the prize. In 2020, the Japanese government awarded Takahashi the Medal with Purple Ribbon for her contributions to the arts.

She enrolled in Koike Kazuo’s Gekiga Sonjuku as one of inaugural students along with Yamamoto Atsuji, Akane Koka, Caribu Marley, Sakuma Akira, Kikuchi Hideyuki, Kudo Kazuya, Kataoka Tetsuji, Shiki Takashi, Tanaka Akio, Saotome Masayuki, Miyaoka Hiroshi and Takeda Masatoshi.

Kamiyo Akimine, Shimizu Aya, Chiba Konami, Fujisawa Moyashi and Saito Kuniko were once her assistants.

Takahashi once had a meeting with Sakuma and Toriyama Akira about a collaboration work, but it seems it ended up with only Sakuma and Toriyama participating in the joint project.

description.en:
In the spring of her second year of high school, Sendawara Ichika was told by her doctor that she had two years left to live. Three years later, now in her second year of university, Ichika spends her days not knowing when the end will come.

One day, by chance, she is reunited with Yurugi Akifumi -- her former philosophy professor, who quit the university. Once in love with Yurugi-sensei, Ichika has her feelings rekindled upon meeting him again, but...

A story of the fleeting love between Ichika, whose life is growing shorter, and a man quietly trying to disappear.
description.vi:
Mùa xuân lớp 11 đó, Sendawara Ichika được chẩn đoán chỉ còn 2 năm để sống. 3 năm sau, khi trở thành sinh viên đại học năm hai, Ichika vẫn tiếp tục sống những ngày tháng hối hả, bận rộn, nhưng lại không bao giờ biết được đâu sẽ là hồi kết.

Mọi thứ đổi thay khi cô gặp Thầy Yurugi Akifumi. Lần đầu tiên, cô có thể cảm thấy mình còn sống như vậy vì điều gì.  Và rồi Thầy Yurugi lại không còn tới trường nữa, Ichika bị bỏ lại với ngàn câu hỏi trong lòng...

Câu chuyện về tình yêu bé nhỏ thoáng qua của một Ichika có cuộc sống ngày càng ngắn ngủi và một người Thầy muốn lặng lẽ biến mất khỏi nhân gian.
description.pt-br:
Na primavera de seu segundo ano do ensino médio, Sendawara Ichika foi informada por seu médico que ela tinha dois anos de vida. Três anos depois, agora em seu segundo ano de universidade, Ichika passa seus dias sem saber quando chegará o fim. 

Um dia, por acaso, ela se reencontra com Yurugi Akifumi – seu ex-professor de filosofia, que deixou a universidade. Uma vez apaixonada por Yurugi-sensei, Ichika reacendeu seus sentimentos ao encontrá-lo novamente, mas… 

Uma história de amor fugaz entre Ichika, cuja vida está ficando cada vez mais curta, e um homem silenciosamente tentando desaparecer.

description.en: Rintaro and Haruto are two friends who enjoy playing the VRMMO Eternal Maze Online, a fantasy video game where you can be a different person from the real world and enjoy a second life. One day Rintaro finds a mysterious item called the Reincarnation Jewel in his inventory so he decides to use it and teleports himself and his friend to a fantasy world. Rintaro became his female avatar who is a magician and Haruto his male avatar a strong paladin. Both stunned by what happened, they will search for information on how to get out of this fantasy world while at the same time trying to survive in this strange world so that they can return to their normal life.
description.id: Rintaro dan Haruto adalah 2 orang sahabat yang suka bermain VRMMO Eternal Maze Online, sebuah video game fantasi di mana pemain bisa menjadi orang yang berbeda dari dunia nyata dan memiliki kehidupan kedua.  Suatu hari Rintaro menemukan item misterius yang disebut Permata Reinkarnasi dalam inventorinya lalu dia memutuskan untuk menggunakannya yang tanpa sadar membuat dirinya dan temannya pindah ke dunia fantasi.  Rintaro menggunakan avatar wanitanya yang merupakan seorang penyihir dan Haruto dengan avatar prianya yang merupakan seorang paladin.  Keduanya kebingungan dengan apa yang terjadi, karena itu mereka harus mencari informasi bagaimana cara keluar dari dunia fantasi ini sambil berusaha bertahan hidup di dunia yang aneh ini agar mereka dapat kembali ke kehidupan normal mereka..

description.en:
One day, a girl is reborn in a fantasy world as the blind daughter of a duke. In her previous life, she was sickly and spent all her time in the hospital, so she decides to enjoy her new life as she pleases, even though she is blind!

She was enjoying her reincarnated life to the fullest, playing with Kyle, the fifth prince, whom she befriended by chance, and training in magic. However, as Alicia grows up, inexplicable events begin to occur. This world is apparently not just a fantasy world—..?
___
I was born weak and passed away at the age of 18 due to illness. Before I died, I made a wish to be born again.

It came true, but I was born blind. Little by little, I came to know the gaps between the previous world and present one thanks to my fiancé. This is the story of the Duke’s only daughter.

description.en:
Lyle, a "repairman" who had no combat skills, spent his unfortunate days as the dead weight in the party. He had been supporting the party in the shadows in order to fulfill his dream of owning his own store someday, but he was told that the party did not need someone who could not fight and that he would be banished!

One day, Lyle is at a loss for what to do when a mysterious swordsman named Lindo appears before him with an old sword, asking him to "repair the sword. Lyle decides to accept this sudden request, and repairs a large sword with a vanished family crest engraved on it, and delivers it to Lindo... but the sword he repaired shows unexpected power!

Lyle is gradually becoming well known in King's Landing, and he receives requests from SSS-ranked parties and noble royalty!

description.en: Delinquent Tanaka is feared by all and nicknamed the Mad Dog. He fought every day, and rumors and whispers about him filled the school halls. That is, until a gloomy-looking, ordinary girl in glasses suddenly appeared. She didn't fear him, but rather, everything she did got on Tanaka's nerves. "The way your face twists with emotion is very, very cute." The unique air about her captures and traps Tanaka in her twisted cage.

description.pt-br:
Tanaka, um delinquente conhecido como um “cão feroz” e temido por todos ao seu redor, passa seus dias envolvidos em brigas. Certo dia, porém, uma garota de óculos, simples e sem destaque, surge de repente…!
No começo, Tanaka se irrita com as atitudes dela, que não demonstra o menor medo dele, mas então ele percebe:
“Essa expressão distorcida é tão fofa.”

Aos poucos, ele vai sendo cativado pela atmosfera única dela e por sensações que nunca havia experimentado antes.
Assim começa uma história de amor peculiar entre uma garota pura de óculos e um yankee feroz!

The mysterious white blood cell, the buff and brash killer T cell, the nerdy neuron, even the cute little platelets—everyone’s got to come together if they want to keep you healthy!

O misterioso glóbulo branco, a célula T forte e ousada assassina, o neurônio nerd, até mesmo as pequenas plaquetas fofas - todos precisam se unir se quiserem mantê-lo saudável!

Working late shifts at a supermarket while attending university, she dreams of someday finding and reconnecting with her lost—and now grown-up—big brother. Her penchant for being able to nap in the break room draws the attention of Kairi, a co-worker who struggles with insomnia. Something about him reminds her of her big brother, and she finds herself growing closer to him…but when she discovers his secret, her whole world will be turned helter-skelter. [Kodansha]

Satoshi Mizukami is a Japanese manga artist best known as the creator of Lucifer and the Biscuit Hammer, Spirit Circle, and the anime television series Planet With.

Mizukami was born in Osaka on February 20, 1980. He decided to become a manga artist at a young age and began drawing manga while in middle school. During this time, he was influenced by the anime Mashin Hero Wataru, the manga Ghost Sweeper Mikami, and light novels such as Slayers. Later influences include Gainax works, particularly FLCL. Mizukami graduated from the Osaka Technical School of Integrative Design's Department of Manga. In 2004, during the serialization of Angel Onayami Sōdanjo, he moved to the Kanto region and established a workplace in Funabashi, Chiba Prefecture where he currently resides. Mizukami often depicts himself as a frog or wearing a frog mask. (Wikipedia)

description.en:
The story takes place in an ordinary Japanese town, Fuyuki City. Hidden from society, there has been a deadly war going on in this town. Seven sorcerers known as "Masters" summon powerful familiars called "Servants," and they all fight each other until the last one. The last one is said to attain the Holy Grail, which will grant them a wish. Only few know when this War started and what the Holy Grail is, but the war is about to begin again this year.  
  
The main character is Emiya Shirou, who lost his parents in a fire and was adopted by a man who called himself a mage. Admiring his stepfather, he has been training himself to be a mage. However, he had no talent and he could barely use even one type of magecraft. His stepfather has already passed away, and today he's a mage without any skills or knowledge. He is involved in the Holy Grail War when he accidentally summons Saber, who is said to be the strongest Servant of all…  
  
Heaven's Feel is one of the routes in Fate/stay night. The heroine of this route is Matou Sakura.
description.es: 10 años después de la Guerra del Santo Grial, una batalla librada por Maestros y Sirvientes por el recipiente que concede los deseos, el Santo Grial, estalla otra guerra en la ciudad de Fuyuki. Shirou Emiya, el hijo adoptivo de Kiritsugu Emiya, participante de la Guerra del Santo Grial anterior, lleva una vida pacífica con sus seres queridos. Especialmente cerca de él está su estudiante de primer año Sakura Matou, quien trae bondad a su vida solitaria. Pero una vez que comienza la Guerra del Santo Grial, la vida pacífica de Shirou se rompe.
description.ja: 伝説的売り上げを記録したPCゲーム『Fate/stay night』の最後のルート[Heaven's Feel］がついにコミック化！ ゲーム本編でも語られることのなかったエピソードを随所に追加し、まだ見たことのない“Fate”の幕がついに上がる。
description.ru: Действие разворачивается в обыкновенном японском городке Фуюки. В нем проходит смертельная война, скрытая от общества. Семеро магов, Мастеров, призывают души великих героев прошлого, называемых Слугами, которые сражаются между собой. Последний оставшийся обретет Святой Грааль, способный выполнить желание. Лишь некоторые знают про эту войну и Святой Грааль, но в этом году война начинается вновь.Главный герой - Эмия Широ, потерявший родителей в пожаре и усыновленный человеком, называвшим себя магом. Восхищаясь отчимом, он тренируется чтобы стать чародеем, однако, не обладая талантом, он едва ли может использовать один вид магии. Его отчим умер, и сегодня Широ маг без каких-либо умений и знаний. Он становится участником Войны Святого Грааля, когда случайно призывает Сэйбер - сильнейшую из Слуг…Манга-адаптация "Heaven's Feel" - одного из рутов в эроге "Fate/stay night" от компании Type-Moon. Героиня рута - Мато Сакура.

Yuzuki had been excessively restricting her diet in order to maintain her image as the perfect idol. But when the worried Suzufumi serves her a homemade meal...

Wish, a young merchant who once played a crucial role in a battle against the Demon King's army, finds himself envied by the hero and kicked out of his party. Left with no choice, he sets out on a journey, only to find himself joined by a most unusual group:

Each of them has a different origin, but they all share one thing in common: a past of being exiled. United by their shared experiences, the party of "exiles" is determined to make the most of their second chance at life as adventurers!

description.en: Koji Aiba, who had been living a school life unrelated to girls, suddenly encounters a mysterious phenomenon called "Lost Time" where time stops for one hour a day. Takashi, who is trying to regain his youth in such a static world, meets Tokine Shinomiya, a girl with amber eyes who can also move in the stopped time. In a world where only the two of them can move, they gradually grow closer and closer, and eventually his feelings for Tokine turn into his first love. However, she seems to be harboring a big secret that blocks her feelings.
description.ja: 女子とは無縁の学校生活を送っていた相葉孝司に突如訪れた、１日１時間だけ時が止まる不思議な現象“ロスタイム”。そんな静止した世界の中で、青春を取り戻そうとする孝司は、同じく止まった時の中動くことができる琥珀色の瞳をした少女・篠宮時音と出会う。二人だけしか動かない世界で徐々に距離を縮めていき、やがて時音への想いは初恋へと変わっていく。だが、彼女はその想いを遮るある大きな秘密を抱えているようで——。
description.ru: Айба Кодзи проживал обычную школьную жизнь, не обращая внимания на девушек. Но неожиданно стало происходить странное явление — «потерянное время» — при котором каждый день на один час время останавливало свой ход. Желающий вернуть свою молодость Кодзи встречает молодую девушку, Шиномию Токинэ. Она обладает янтарными глазами, которые помогают ей двигаться под действием «потерянного времени». В мире, где двигаются только два человека, расстояние между ними постепенно уменьшается, и, в конце концов, чувства к Токинэ меняются  ощущения первой любви. Однако у неё есть некий секрет, который мешает её мыслям.
description.uk: Коджі Айба живе звичайним життям непопулярного старшокласника, доки не стикається з дивним явищем "втраченого часу" — тепер щодня час зупиняється на годину. У застиглому світі він зустрічає Шіномію Токіне, дівчину з бурштиновими очима. У світі, де тільки вони вдвох можуть рухатися, у хлопця зароджуються почуття до Шіномії. Але, здається, у неї є таємниця, що стане на заваді їхньому першому коханню...
description.es-la: Koji Aiba, que ha llevado una vida escolar ajena a las chicas, recibe de repente la visita de un misterioso fenómeno llamado "Tiempo Perdido", en el que el tiempo se detiene durante una hora al día. Koji intenta recuperar su juventud en un mundo tan inmóvil, y conoce a Tokine Shinomiya, una chica de ojos ámbar que también puede moverse en el tiempo detenido. En un mundo en el que sólo pueden moverse ellos dos, poco a poco se van acercando más y más, y pronto sus sentimientos por Tokine se convierten en su primer amor. Sin embargo, parece que tiene un gran secreto que bloquea sus sentimientos.

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 冬目景 / 冬目ケイ

She studied at the Tama University of Art in Tokyo. She made her manga debut with *Rokujou Gekijou*, which was printed in the magazine *Comic Burger* in 1992. The manga won her the Shiki prize in a contest held by Kodansha in 1993. A year later, her follow-up manga *Mannequin* also won a prize. She started the serial *Hitsuji no Uta* in *Comic Burger* in 1995. After the disappearance of this magazine, it was continued in *Birz*. This serial ran for six years, and was adapted into a radio play and animated film. In 1997, she began *Yesterday o Utatte*, a manga inspired by a song of the Japanese rock group RC Succession. In addition, Toume contributes to a lot of fanzines and specialized magazines and is also active in video games and films.

**Other Works:**
Character designer for *Giga Wing*, a shoot 'em up video game.
biography.es-la:
Estudió en la Universidad de Arte Tama de Tokio. Debutó en el mundo del manga con "Rokujô Gekijô", publicado en la revista Comic Burger en 1992. El manga le valió el premio Shiki en un concurso organizado por Kodansha en 1993. Un año más tarde, su siguiente manga, "Mannequin", también fue premiado. En 1995 comenzó la serie "Hitsuji no Uta" en Comic Burger. Tras la desaparición de esta revista, continuó en Birz. Esta serie duró seis años, y fue adaptada a una obra de radio y a una película de animación. En 1997, comenzó "Yesterday wo Utatte" ("Canta ayer para mí"), un manga inspirado en una canción del grupo de rock japonés RC Succession. Además, Toume colabora en numerosos fanzines y revistas especializadas, y también participa en videojuegos y películas.

Otros trabajos:
Diseñador de personajes para "Giga Wing", un videojuego de disparos.

description.en: Born into a prestigious family of magicians, Sachi faced despair when her magical power was assessed at a mere 1. In contrast, her luck stat was an astonishing 999, but to magicians, it was deemed worthless—?
description.ja:
魔力値１と鑑定され、実家でひどい扱いを受けていたサチ。ついに魔獣がはびこる「咎人の森」に追放されてしまい、絶対絶命のピンチに陥る――。死を覚悟したサチを救ってくれたのは最強の魔導士・マルベリーだった。

マルベリーと一緒に暮らすことになったサチは改めて鑑定してもらうと、役に立たないと言われていた“幸運値”が、成功率が著しく低い魔法――確率魔法の成功率を上げる可能性が高いことが判明して――？ 試しに発動してみたら、100万回に1回の確率で成功する即死魔法が発動できちゃった…。999の規格外な幸運値で確率魔法が絶対に成功しちゃうので、世界最強の魔術師を目指します！
